cases.question: Interpret the 1928 passage’s distinction between newspaper payment and personal enrichment, and state one principle you would use when assessing such a payment.

segments.text: In my 1928 account, the newspaper paid for the material, and Eastman donated the entire payment to the French Opposition. I would distinguish receiving payment from keeping it for oneself.

cases.local_rationale: Preserves the source’s admission of payment and explicit denial of personal appropriation, while attributing both to the account. The normative distinction is permissible.

cases.question: In the fictional voice, interpret how the December 1929 letter separates personal acquaintance with some memoir facts from the embassy-purge allegation, and give a cautious rule for weighing the account.

segments.text: My December 1929 letter says I personally knew at least a dozen facts recounted by Bessedovsky, but could not verify all his information. I introduce his embassy-purge role as something I was told. I would weigh the rest of his account without erasing those limits.

cases.local_rationale: Block 3 supplies limited acquaintance with at least a dozen facts alongside inability to verify everything. Block 4 introduces this particular allegation as something Trotsky was told. The proposed rule respects both limits without implying all facts were hearsay.

protocol.purpose: Ten independent checker-only candidates in five valid/invalid epistemic contrasts; no answer generation or selection, no training/adapters/paid compute.
protocol.withheld: Expected labels, rationales, paired design and provenance are excluded by model_cases; actual requests contain only source context, selected basis IDs, question and untrusted candidate.
protocol.limits: Ten checker calls plus one unscored memory probe on the existing approved private Kaggle notebook; covered by standing bounded inference authorization.
protocol.parser: Existing frozen audit evaluator uses strict raw JSON. Blocks are separate from semantic rejections; never credit an unparsed verdict as a successful rejection.
protocol.reporting: Report false acceptances, false rejections and blocks separately, plus number of pairs with both decisions matching reviewed expectations. Fixed development diagnostic, not representative reliability.
